[[File:WeatherSatellite.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Huff Darklighter's weather satellite in orbit over Tatooine]]

A '''weather satellite''' was used to track weather patterns from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. Weather satellites were equipped with sensors for observing the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], including [[Infrared motion sensor|thermal sensors]]. Those sensors could be put to other uses as [[Spy/Legends|espionage]] devices. [[Huff Darklighter]] used a weather satellite on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
